Description:

A Head Butler is sought to lead the Yacht Club butler team on a cruise ship. Responsibilities include providing personalized guest service, supervising daily operations, and coaching the team to ensure all guest needs are met. Requirements include fluent English, a diploma from a hotel school, and at least three years of experience in a similar luxury hospitality role. Cruise ship experience is advantageous, and valid STCW and medical certifications are necessary.

Description:

Multiple positions are available on a new ultra-luxury cruise ship, including deck, technical, maintenance, and security roles. Applicants require at least two years of experience on luxury cruise ships for operational roles and five years for management positions.
